February 14, 1971
2014-12-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/february-14-1971-55347

Calling for National Assembly Session on March 3 in Dhaka, President Yahya Khan says the session will start at 9:00am at Provincial Assembly Hall in Dhaka to formulate the governance policy. Quoting PPI, Daily Pakistan reports, different political parties in Dhaka welcome the president’s call for session on March 3. However, Awami League does not make any comment on this matter.

People’s Party Chairman Zulfikar Ali Bhutto discusses the issue of governance policy with Pakistan Muslim League Chief Abdul Qayyum Khan and Maulana Mufti Mahmud, general secretary of Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam in Peshwar. Following the meeting Abdul Qayyum says he is not cynic about the outcome of the discussion.
